items.name: Strait of Hormuz
items.reason: Cargo and hulls insured for Gulf voyages; war-risk cover has been withdrawn or repriced since March 2026.

items.name: Strait of Malacca
items.reason: Busiest lane for the insured cargo and for coal and palm-oil exports.

items.name: Taiwan Strait
items.reason: A blockade or incident would disrupt marine cargo to East Asia.

items.name: Saudi Arabia
items.reason: Hajj and Umrah travel from Indonesia, and migrant workers there.

items.name: Port of Singapore
items.reason: Transhipment hub for cargo and the main reinsurance marketplace.

items.name: China
items.reason: Largest buyer of Indonesian coal; its demand moves cargo volumes.

items.name: Malaysia
items.reason: Neighbour for haze, migrant workers and trade.
